sn35.234:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca ānando, āyasmā ca udāyī kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
sn35.234:1.2: atha kho āyasmā udāyī sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn35.234:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.234:2.1: yatheva nu kho āvuso ānanda, ayaṃ kāyo bhagavatā anekapariyāyena akkhāto vivaṭo pakāsito,
sn35.234:2.2: itipāyaṃ kāyo anattāti. sakkā evamevaṃ viññāṇampidaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ itipidaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattāti.
sn35.234:3.1: yatheva kho āvuso udāyī ayaṃ kāyo bhagavatā aneka pariyāyena akkhāto vivaṭo pakāsito,
sn35.234:3.2: itipāyaṃ kāyo anattāti, sakkā evameva viññāṇampidaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ itipidaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattāti.
sn35.234:4.3: yo cāvuso hetu yo ca paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyya, api nu kho cakkhu viññāṇaṃ paññāyethāti.
sn35.234:4.5: imināpi kho etaṃ āvuso pariyāyena bhagavatā akkhātaṃ vivaṭaṃ pakāsitaṃ: itipidaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattāti. …pe…
sn35.234:5.3: yo cāvuso hetu yo ca paccayo jivhā viññāṇassa uppādāya, so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyya, apinu kho jivhāviññāṇaṃ paññāyethāti.
sn35.234:5.5: imināpi kho etaṃ āvuso pariyāyena bhagavatā akkhātaṃ vivaṭaṃ pakāsitaṃ itipidaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattāti …pe…
sn35.234:6.3: yo cāvuso hetu yo ca paccayo manoviññāṇassa uppādāya, so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyya. api nu kho manoviññāṇaṃ paññāyethāti.
sn35.234:6.5: imināpi kho etaṃ āvuso pariyāyena bhagavatā akkhātaṃ vivaṭaṃ pakāsitaṃ itipidaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattāti.
sn35.234:7.1: seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha passeyya mahantaṃ kadalikkhandhaṃ ujukaṃ navaṃ akukkukajātaṃ. tamenaṃ mūle chindeyya mūle chetvā agge chindeyya agge chetvā pattaṃ vaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujeyya, so tattha pheggumpi nādhigaccheyya, kuto sāraṃ.
sn35.234:7.2: evameva kho āvuso bhikkhu chassu phassāyatanesu neva attānaṃ nānattaniyaṃ samanupassati.
sn35.234:7.3: so evaṃ asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati.
sn35.234:7.4: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
sn35.234:7.5: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
